description: A diagnostic method for FCI pre-test answers in which each question's largest incorrect response is normalised and questions above a threshold are flagged as dominant misconceptions.
title: Dominant misconceptions (nDM) diagnostic method

description: The article applies the dose–response framework, borrowed from medicine and pharmacology, to academic intervention: the dose–response curve represents the relation between an intervention's intensity and its effects.
title: Dose–response framework with dosage defined as cumulative intensity
